name: SEG C3 Ground Roll
description: The SEGC3 (SEG China 3D) dataset is a synthetic 3D seismic survey based on a complex geological model. It includes 9 shot lines with 201 crosslines and 201 inlines each, sampled at 625 time samples. Synthetic ground-roll noise is injected to create a standard testbed for coherent noise suppression methods.

name: Sichuan Basin Land Survey
description: Real onshore vibroseis records from the Sichuan Basin featuring strong ground-roll and ambient cultural noise. Reference clean volumes are obtained through long-stack averaging, providing a realistic field-data testbed for denoising algorithms.

name: Synthetic Super-Resolution
description: High-resolution synthetic marine shot gathers and their 2× downsampled counterparts. Designed for benchmarking seismic super-resolution methods on recovering spatially subsampled data.

name: SEG C3 Random Noise
description: The SEGC3 (SEG China 3D) dataset injected with synthetic random noise (Gaussian and Poisson) at varying SNR levels. Designed for benchmarking random noise suppression and denoising algorithms on 3D seismic data.

name: First-Break Picking SEG-Y Dataset with Masks
description: Field first-break picking dataset containing paired SEG-Y amplitude records and binary step-mask labels from Brunswick, Halfmile, and Lalor surveys. Designed for benchmarking first-arrival picking and step-mask segmentation algorithms on real land seismic data.

name: SEG C3 Interpolation
description: The SEGC3 (SEG China 3D) dataset for seismic trace interpolation benchmarks. Synthetic traces are removed under random, uniform, and continuous missing patterns at varying levels to test interpolation and reconstruction algorithms on 3D seismic data.
